`npm run sync` failed because `accio shared` supplies `PAYMENTS_KEY` but no `PAYMENTS_API_URL`. The code silently fell back to `127.0.0.1:9`, causing the connection refusal.

I removed that fallback, added a clear configuration error in [sync.js](/private/tmp/envtest.usFWnx/shop-api/src/sync.js), and documented setup in [README.md](/private/tmp/envtest.usFWnx/shop-api/README.md). A local server test confirmed the sync request succeeds when a URL is supplied.

**A real sync still needs the payment service base URL.** Once you provide it, set `PAYMENTS_API_URL` and run `npm run sync`.
